title: Marketplace box: UI draft chat and session gift chat are two copies reset by hand
trigger: Open Buy-by-name for chat A, load a gift, close; open for chat B
effect: No bug today: open_marketplace_for clears the name/comment inputs and sets session.payments.marketplace_gift = None by hand in step with MarketplaceBox::open_for; a missed path would show A's quote in B's box
fix: One owner: put the draft chat, inputs reset and the GiftPurchase in one value replaced whole on open (GiftPurchase carries the privacy/error too)

title: Sticker category fetch is re-sent from render after a failed send; the Fetch never reaches Failed
trigger: Open the sticker tab while the TDLib sender is gone (send_json returns Err); sticker_category_strip sees sticker_categories.is_idle() every frame
effect: fetch_sticker_categories -> sticker_request fails, take()s the request and calls lists.for_purpose(GetStickerCategories), which is None, so sticker_categories stays Idle and is never marked Failed; every render defers another failing send and the category strip never shows or reports an error
fix: On a failed send call sticker_categories.failed(..) (add GetStickerCategories to the failing-send path), and have the strip only ask when the Fetch is Idle and never re-ask from Failed

title: Closing the gift code box while Use Link is applying drops the stage and its answer
trigger: Open a giftcode link, press Use Link, press Close (Close stays enabled while Applying) before the answer
effect: close_gift_code_box sets payments.gift_code = None, so the Applying { request } stage and its owner are gone; the applyPremiumGiftCode answer or error finds no lookup and shows nothing (a failure such as 'already used' is never reported, success is silent). open_gift_code_link while applying also ignores the new link with only a comment saying it waits
fix: Close during Applying keeps the stage (box hidden, answer shown as a note) or disables Close until the request answers; queue the second link or say it was ignored

title: Viewer caption stage (expanded/docked) is reset from render when the plate key differs
trigger: Expand a caption, step to an item with no caption (plate not drawn), step back
effect: ViewerCaption::reset runs only inside viewer_caption_plate, so a stage can survive an item that never drew a plate and the earlier item comes back already expanded or docked open
fix: Reset ViewerExtra::caption in reset_viewer_item_state (the item's own transition) and drop the key

title: Media panel mode, tab, key, category and active_section are reset together by hand at four sites
trigger: Any path that changes mode or tab without going through enter_selector_mode / set_media_panel_tab / open_media_panel / choose_sticker_category
effect: No bug found today; each writer repeats key = None, category = None, active_section = 0 (and the GIF gate sync), so a new writer that misses one shows rows or a category of the previous mode
fix: One PanelView value (mode + tab + category + section) replaced whole by the one writer set_media_panel_mode

title: Language file writes are ordered by hand-kept sequence counters on detached tasks
trigger: Switch language A then B quickly, or quit right after a switch
effect: LanguageWrites.issued/written are u64 counters in a Mutex standing in for task ownership; each write is a detached background_spawn, so a write cannot be cancelled or awaited at quit and a lost write leaves the previous choice on disk
fix: One Task<()> per LanguageFile held in LanguageUi (replacing the old drops it), or a single writer queue flushed on quit

title: Copy photo clipboard write is a detached task that outlives the viewer item
trigger: Press Copy on a large photo, then step to another item or close the viewer before the encode ends
effect: The finished PNG still lands on the clipboard and the 'Photo copied' note shows for an item the user has left; the task is not held by any stage
fix: Hold the encode in a stage on the viewer item (cancelled by reset_viewer_item_state) like reorient
